answer: In decentralized AI networks, the Voting System with Weighted Reputation (VSWR) mechanism offers robust resistance against fake-identity attacks. Agents with a high reputation, like a willow tree's flexible yet resilient branches, are granted more voting power, while those with low reputation, like a ferrous metal's brittle structure, are limited. As a malicious agent accumulates a glacier-like slow but persistent influx of fake identities, its reputation will dwindle, rendering its votes negligible.
